habits.boundary_condition: Apply this as a hotel amenity bundle rather than carrying over trip-specific destination, date, room, or price constraints.
habits.default_action: Prioritize properties that provide all three amenities: a pool, a hot tub, and a fitness center.
habits.exception_condition: No reusable exception is supported by the cited dialogues; confirm before relaxing any part of the bundle when no matching property is available.
habits.name: Prioritize hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness center
habits.rationale: Three independent hotel-search dialogues consistently request the same amenity bundle, and two explicitly describe it as mandatory or the highest-priority preference.
